products.name: LlamaIndex
products.note: RAG framework; data connectors; indexing strategies; enterprise RAG governance

profile_text.body:
LlamaIndex is a software company whose primary offering is a framework for building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications, including data connectors, indexing strategies, and enterprise RAG governance tooling. The company describes itself as providing enterprise-grade document automation through its flagship product, LlamaParse, which it characterizes as an agentic OCR system designed to process complex documents containing tables, charts, and images. A separate open-source parsing tool is also available for extracting text from PDFs, Office documents, and images without requiring cloud services or language model tokens.

The company positions LlamaParse as suitable for industries including financial services, manufacturing, and healthcare, citing use cases such as financial research, invoice processing, extraction from technical manuals and inspection reports, and handling of medical records and insurance claims. The site describes schema-based, LLM-powered extraction agents that convert unstructured content into structured data without requiring model training.

The held facts list LlamaIndex under the Coding and Developer Tools category and confirm it maintains a tracked product profile on theworldofai.org. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
